scope: ERNA/C_WITCH standard and travel body frames only; 54 frames each gear; source-coordinate candidate data, no renderer changes
rendererCoordinateNote: EquipmentDetailRenderer treats normalized registration point as SKSpriteNode center. The legacy field placement_px_top_left was misleading; this draft uses measured hem marker as center for BODY01.
reviewBasis: All 54 standard/travel rows were checked on existing marked 16px source grid contacts, not inferred from alpha. BODY01 anchors are candidate points at visible outer hem trim; BODY02 lining remains unresolved/hidden where no distinct inner face can be identified.
